label: PF Backlog 463
title: Add Reconciliation-before-implementation rule to AGENTS.md + ADDING playbook (general guard)
body:
Source: user feedback (2026-10-07) after an implementation drifted from an already-made decision (worker
scope). General guard, not a plane-specific patch.

Failure class: acting on an UN-RECONCILED ASSUMPTION - extrapolating scope/behaviour that is neither in a
recorded decision nor provable from the code, and designing before finding the code that already owns the path.

Add a mandatory RECONCILIATION block before any design/implementation (any change):
  PRIOR DECISIONS - every recorded decision the change touches (quote + id/source).
  EXISTING PATH   - per capability: does it already exist? owner + file:line.
  ASSUMPTIONS     - every assumption NOT backed by a recorded decision or the code.
  DIVERGENCES     - where the change would differ from a prior decision or an existing owner.
  OPEN QUESTIONS  - what the user must confirm.
Rules: no assumption implemented unconfirmed; no silent divergence (amend the decision record first); decisions
are an append-only ledger cited by implementations; unknowns are investigated, never extrapolated.

Scope: (1) add the binding section to product-forge/AGENTS.md (before the pre-implementation review section);
(2) reference the block + template in docs/ADDING-TO-PRODUCT-FORGE.md ("Common steps (every change)").
Out of scope: the advisory tool scripts/dev/reconcile_check.py (separate item).

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false - process/governance docs; no UI surface.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS (13 gates) - docs-only change, --full not required. Adds the binding Reconciliation-before-implementation section to AGENTS.md + the step-0 reference in docs/ADDING-TO-PRODUCT-FORGE.md.
